{"version":1,"taskId":"0b171c40-23da-46e8-926b-bdffbe28f898","commandId":"inspect-1","operation":"run","headSha":"fe890d7c4a1756f69b9c126df7d1866e70bcd9c6","command":"echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo MERGE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none); echo BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); git status --short; wc -l src/main.ts vitest.config.ts; echo '=== markers main.ts ==='; grep -n '^\\(<<<<<<<\\|=======\\|>>>>>>>\\)' src/main.ts; echo '=== vitest.config.ts ==='; cat vitest.config.ts","timeoutSeconds":300}
